name: io.github.reiarseni/mockpost
description: Local multi-channel message emulator for end-to-end testing: captures outgoing email (SMTP), Telegram, WhatsApp, SMS (Twilio), Web Push (real VAPID), FCM, APNs, Slack, Discord, Stripe, OTP codes and fake OAuth sessions (Google, GitHub, Facebook, X); simulates inbound events and signed webhooks (Stripe-Signature, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Twitter-Webhooks-Signature) back to your app, with a unified web timeline, per-app isolation via fake credentials, and MCP tools for LLM agents to inspect and drive test runs.

MOCKPOST_URL.description: Base URL of the MockPost HTTP service (default http://localhost:8090)
